english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for restoring battery power, and it is also used figuratively for taking time to rest and regain energy.
Use this colloquial Hong Kong verb when replenishing a battery or a device's battery.

examples.english: My phone is dead, so I need to recharge it.
examples.traditional: 我部電話冇電，要攞去叉電喇。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 bou6 din6 waa2 mou5 din6 jiu3 lo2 heoi3 caa1 din6 laa3

examples.english: My phone is out of battery, so I need to charge it first.
examples.traditional: 我部電話冇電，要叉電先。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 bou6 din6 waa2 mou5 din6 jiu3 caa1 din6 sin1
